Method: sdcFieldToProtobufMsg(Record record, Field field, String fieldPath, Descriptors.Descriptor desc, Map<String,Set<Descriptors.FieldDescriptor>> messageTypeToExtensionMap, Map<String,Object> defaultValueMap) throws DataGeneratorException

It returns DynamicMessage. It checks if field null -> return null. Builds DynamicMessage.Builder builder = DynamicMessage.newBuilder(desc). It collects fields from descriptor and extensions. Then gets valueAsMap from field.getValueAsMap() (root field is a Map). For each field descriptor f: if f.isMapField() -> handleMapField(...). else if f.isRepeated() -> handleRepeatedField(...). else -> handleNonRepeatedField(...). Method signature: public float[] DM_RPKG(int isword, int nword, int decimalScale) throws IOException

It reads data packing type float[] data; int ipktyp = DM_RINT(isword); int iiword = isword + 1; int lendat = nword - 1;

If ipktyp == MDGNON: no packing, read floats into data array of length lendat, return.

Else, determine iiw and irw based on ipktyp: MDGDIF => iiw=4, irw=3; MDGRB2 => iiw=4, irw=1; else iiw=3, irw=2.

Read iarray of length iiw, then rarray of length irw. Update iiword and lendat accordingly.

If ipktyp == MDGRB2: data = unpackGrib2Data(iiword, lendat, iarray, rarray); return.
